objective: Verify finite, active gradients for a differentiable top-2 recurrent RWKV read with learned abstention under the actual correct-versus-zero, donor, and layer-permuted teacher-forced contrastive objective.

authorization_basis.observed_outcome: Every candidate preserved causal materiality, state invariants, and finite logits, but the best differentiable top-2 route reached only 0.5024469495 weakest-layer mean peak probability against the locked 0.55 gate.
authorization_basis.protocol_response: Do not lower the concentration gate; calibrate the first preregistered top-2 abstention candidate under direct causal contrast supervision.

architecture.projected_bundle_role: causally inert on read and frozen in optimization
architecture.router_gradient: ordinary masked top-2 softmax backward with no straight-through estimator

training.objective: correct answer CE plus active signed CE ranking terms against donor and layer-permuted recurrent state; zero state activates the positive coefficient

stopping_rule.pass: Authorize an eight-update contrastive training screen followed by a fixed already-open teacher-forced causal endpoint gate before generation.
stopping_rule.failure: Reject top-k routing and add explicit token-level retrieval supervision.
stopping_rule.always: Archive, commit, and push the result.

claim_policy.calibration_pass: May claim only finite active trainability under the causal contrastive objective.
claim_policy.native_gain: Forbidden until a held-out open native causal gate and authorized development generation both pass.
claim_policy.protected_replication: Forbidden without a new preregistered protocol.
